features.name: Power BI Finance App
features.description: Six new Power BI apps with one for finance containing 14 reports, including overview pages, KPI pages with drill-through to ledger entries for validation and investigation.

features.name: Financial Reporting Templates
features.description: Five row definitions for balance sheet and income statement, plus 12 predefined column definitions allowing mix and match to create various financial reports.

features.name: Excel Reports for Fixed Assets
features.description: Three new Excel reports for fixed assets covering analysis with book value, projected value showing appreciation projections, and details. One additional consolidation report for fixed assets.

features.name: Ad Hoc Analysis for Fixed Assets
features.description: Query-based analysis view combining data from fixed asset tables with multiple dimensions and dates, allowing creation of custom reports and co-pilot assisted report generation.

features.name: Financial Analytics Documentation
features.description: New documentation content covering financial reporting overview, how to perform analytics in Business Central, financial reporting module setup, and step-by-step guides for creating row and column definitions.

features.name: New Demo Data Sets
features.description: Three new demo data sets for financial reporting (3 years with budget and dimension breakdown), fixed assets (depreciation, acquisition, maintenance entries), and projects (extensive period with profitability analysis).
